items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: That's what Slowdrag wanted to tell me.

ctx.x: You don't remember the Golden Rule band? You remember that? Golden Rule, band downtown. But that didn't stay up long. No, it didn't last long. So, Creole and a sudden used to have that band. Manuel used to play in there too.

Pico. That's right. That's what Slowdrag wanted to tell me. That was the first band. Had an uniform. But I know better. The first band had an uniform before the Golden Rule. You take the Pacific had an uniform. Oh, the Pacific. Yeah, that's the Grass Band. That's right. Yeah, the Grass Band. You take... I had a picture of the Pacific there with them. Remember them hats? Yeah, with them. Called them like a scoop.
